name: The Crowd Turns
flavor: Every performer's nightmare, handed to somebody else: the room decides it does not like you, and you can feel it happen.
description: You turn the mood of the room against creatures of your choice within a 15-foot radius of a point you can see within range. Each of them that can hear and understand you makes a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. On a failure it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. This deals no damage. Casting this costs 2 Mirth, spent as you cast; like every costed Turn it generates none back.
narration: You do not insult them. You simply let the room know how this is going, and they feel every eye in it land on them at once.
sheetSummary: 15-ft radius. Creatures of your choice that can hear and understand you: Wisdom save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}} or disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. No damage.
